text:
ajay: Morning — async standup. What I did: finished cloud KMS key inventory, flagged 3 keys missing rotation tags. Blockers: need 2FA on automation runner to actually test rotation (waiting on ops ticket). Today: plan to land the KMS rotation script + run smoke tests. Ping @marie for service-account perms.

marie: thanks — saw the inventory. Can you paste the key IDs so I can grant SA perms? :thumbsup:

ajay: key list pasted below: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/key-1`, `.../key-2`, `.../key-3`. Quick test command I'm running: ```gcloud kms keys versions create --key key-1 --location global --keyring main --project redwood-prod```

devon: quick FYI — vuln scanner flagged a high CVE in the Redis image used by audit-runner. I opened PR #2048 to bump base image. @taylor can you take a look?

taylor: will review today, looks like a one-line bump. Also pushed a tiny infra IAM policy tweak to `infra/iam/roles.yaml` that should let the runbook SA call `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.setIamPolicy`. link: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/4a5b

sec-oncall: FYI there was a non-prod KMS error last night: `permissionDenied: requestor lacks iam.serviceAccounts.get`. Rolled back last config change at 03:12 UTC, no customer impact.

ajay: noted. I opened OPS-123 to add the SA binding and a canary job to test rotation against a subset of keys before full rollout.

marie: granting SA perms now, pinged ops for the 2FA request. I'll run the rotation smoke test after @ajay uploads the script. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: audit-runner/2026-03-16T20:12Z -> staging :rocket:

taylor: rotation test script (WIP):
```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
KEY=$1
# create a new key version then promote
gcloud kms keys versions create --key $KEY --location global --keyring main --project redwood-prod
# quick check
gcloud kms keys versions list --key $KEY --location global --keyring main --project redwood-prod | tail -n1
```

marie: running against key-1/key-2/key-3 now, will post results in a few.

marie: results: key-1 rotation OK, key-2 failed with `rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded` during setIamPolicy. Retrying with exponential backoff. :thinking_face:

ajay: thanks — that smells like API rate limiting from the infra control plane. I'll add retry middleware to the rotation runner and requeue key-2 for tonight's canary run.

devon: PR #2048 assigned to @taylor and @marie for review. No blockers from my side.

taylor: ack, will review in the next hour. No other blockers.

sec-oncall: compliance note: SOC2 evidence needs a rotation artifact for key-2 by EOD. If we can't rotate key-2, mark an exception and open CAPA. I've added a tracker item: COMPLY-482.

ajay: copying that — will prioritize key-2. If rotation still fails after retries, I'll draft an exception doc and upload logs to the COMPLY-482 ticket.

(End of thread)
